description: Waterfall enrichment: providers are tried in order per field until one returns a value or the budget is spent. Same shape a Clay table encodes, kept here so the order and cost are reviewable and testable.

crm.description: Existing record in the system of record. Always first, always free.

sos_filings.description: State business registry: registered agent and officers.

maps.description: Maps listing: phone, address, review count, sometimes owner responses.

website_scrape.description: About or contact page, LLM-extracted owner name with a QA pass.

apollo.description: Contact data provider. Paid per match.

hunter.description: Email finder. Paid per found address.

pattern_guess.description: first@domain from a known pattern. Must be verified before use; never enrolls unverified.

rules: crm is always the first provider so paid lookups never run for data we already own.
A pattern_guess email is tagged source=pattern_guess and routed to verification, never straight to a sequence.
Per-field budgets cap spend per account; a field that blows its budget is left empty and the account routes by what it has (call_first if no email).
